turns.q: Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
turns.replyTail:
This is the best starting point if you want the core tools for actually grilling.
• Grill brush and scraper: this is for cleaning the grill before or after cooking.
• Bristle-free brush sets: these are also for cleaning, but with replaceable heads instead of a traditional bristle brush.
• FlavrQ starter kit: this is more of an add-on for gas grills if you want stronger charcoal-style flavor and hotter searing.

If you are brand new, the 3-piece grill set is the easiest place to start.
